advertisers.title: Advertisers
advertisers.description: Brand names (Nike), domains (bmw.com, pepsico.com), or a Google Ads Transparency AR advertiser id. One lookup is run per item across the selected ad libraries.

region.title: Region
region.description: ISO country code used as the primary region (e.g. US, GB, DE). Google Ads Transparency uses this directly. TikTok's public Ad Library covers EU/EEA, UK, Brazil and Turkey; a US request is searched in GB and noted on the summary.

platforms.title: Platforms
platforms.description: Ad libraries to query. Meta and LinkedIn are parked in this version when their public pages are not reliably reachable without a login; they are still listed on the summary so you can see the gap.

maxAdsPerPlatform.title: Max ads per platform
maxAdsPerPlatform.description: Cap on ads fetched (and charged) from each library for each advertiser.

maxAdsPerAdvertiser.title: Max ads per advertiser
maxAdsPerAdvertiser.description: Optional overall cap across all libraries for one advertiser. Defaults to max ads per platform times the number of platforms.

maxTotal.title: Max ads in total
maxTotal.description: Optional hard cap on ad records across all advertisers in this run.

compareWithLastRun.title: Mark ads new since last run
compareWithLastRun.description: When on, ad ids are compared to a snapshot in a named key-value store. First run builds the baseline (isNewSinceLastRun is false). Later runs flag new creatives.

snapshotStoreName.title: Snapshot store name
snapshotStoreName.description: Named Apify key-value store used to remember the last ad-id set per advertiser and region. Same name across scheduled runs enables the diff.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: How many advertisers to query in parallel (keep low to avoid rate limits).
